In ''[[PTP02|Regionals]]'', Celestine was reunited with her rival again at the regional championship, after teasing Ava, Celestine had a match against [[Ava's father]] and despite Ava's father being an experienced player, he was defeated in a single round by Celestine. During the remainder of the competition, Celestine was beating her opponents one by one, and managed to reach the finals where she would finally face Ava. {{left clear}} ==Character== Celestine is considered the school's best [[Pokémon Trading Card Game]] player, during her encounter with Ava, she was shown to have a menacing and imposing posture. ==Pokémon competitions== * [[Play!
